summary: CR-385 v2.15 Auto-print check-in receipt tested on ?checkin=a2 at 1920x800 and mobile 390x844. Checkbox default (from CI_SETTINGS.autoPrintReceipt=true) is CHECKED, source hint reads '· default from Settings: On'. Toggle works and persists across in-place redraws (typing in checkin-collect-now). ON flow: confirm toast contains 'receipt auto-printed (MOCKED)' and pane closes. OFF flow: toast contains 'no receipt printed'. Regression: checkout bills 107 (0) and 103 (2,677) unchanged. Mobile: autoprint row visible, no horizontal overflow. No JS console errors on any page load.

ui_bugs.issue: Slight internal scroll re-introduced after adding the auto-print row on fresh ?checkin=a2 load at 1920x800: scrollHeight=392 > clientHeight=369 (23px overflow). Confirm button rect.bottom=736 is still within the 800px viewport, so Confirm remains visible, but the v2.14 'no internal scroll' invariant (sh <= ch) is broken.

action_items: Reduce RIGHT .ci-pane-body content height by ~24px (e.g., tighten spacing/margins around checkin-autoprint-row or .ci-payment-actions) so scrollHeight <= clientHeight is restored at 1920x800 on fresh ?checkin=a2 load.
critical_code_review_comments: The auto-print row rendering + confirm-toast wording logic works exactly as spec'd (default from CI_SETTINGS, per-check-in override via ciEdit('printReceipt',...), toast branch based on c.d.printReceipt). Only concern is the layout-height regression noted above.
context_for_next_testing_agent: v2.15 feature functional behaviour is 100% correct (default checked, toggle+persist, ON toast='receipt auto-printed', OFF toast='no receipt printed', pane closes, mobile OK, no console errors). Only regression: right pane body has 23px internal scroll on fresh a2 load (sh=392 ch=369). Confirm still at bottom=736 so still within 800 viewport. Retest ONLY the RIGHT column scrollHeight/clientHeight metric after main agent trims spacing. Checkout regressions bill=107 (0) and bill=103 (2,677) both pass.
rca of the issue: Adding the auto-print checkbox row above .ci-payment-actions in .ci-pane-foot increases the total content height of [data-testid=checkin-right-col] .ci-pane-body by ~23px, exceeding clientHeight=369 on 1920x800 on fresh ?checkin=a2 (no scroll interaction). Mitigation: reduce vertical padding/margin on the new .ci-pane-foot row (or on adjacent .ci-payment-actions / Balance rows) to reclaim ~24px so sh <= ch again.
